title: Resolve ordinary legacy checkpoint authority outside the global state lock
outcome: Ordinary legacy checkpoint route resolution performs filesystem work outside StateInner while preserving the frozen original route and final owner checks.
acceptance: Move or cache legacy marker/home/store resolution through the existing binding or checkpoint owner without holding StateInner across filesystem calls.
Preserve conservative unconfirmed legacy authority, exact original request and owner fencing, OFF enablement validation and both pre-send durability cuts.
Cover changed-marker or stale-owner refusal and the healthy already-bound missing-executable route with appropriate focused tests and independent reviews.
